questions.stem: Why is carbon able to form so many different compounds?

options.text: It can only form ionic bonds with other elements
It can form 4 covalent bonds and bond to other carbon atoms to make chains, branches, and rings
It is the most abundant element on Earth
It has a very high melting point

questions.explanation: Carbon has 4 electrons in its outer shell, allowing it to form 4 covalent bonds. It can bond to other carbon atoms to create chains, branches, and rings, which is why it forms more compounds than all other elements combined.
